ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel base with approximately 25-30% high-intensity pixel distribution concentrated in localized mottling and linear patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottle-blobs are concentrated in the proximal-medial region of the left lobe; the right lobe contains a high density of fine, intersecting linear high-intensity marks across its lateral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetric V-shaped depression; the exact vertex is obscured by water spray, but the observable boundaries converge at an angle of approximately 60-70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular peaks and valleys along the entire span; a prominent, high-amplitude jagged excision is visible on the medial-lateral transition of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-upward trajectory for the main span of both lobes, terminating in slightly convex curvatures at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized circular clusters of high-intensity pixels situated at the extreme lateral distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density network of multi-directional, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) distributed extensively across the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular macro-notch/excision on the trailing edge of the left lobe, distinct from the surrounding micro-serration pattern.
